name: Enterprise Real Estate Lead Qualification Engine

parameters.content:
## REAL ESTATE QUALIFICATION ENGINE
- **Lane A**: Meta Lead capture, deduplication, E-Brochure + Purpose delivery.
- **Lane B**: Webhook verification, HMAC validation, 200 OK ACK, 5-stage interactive button qualification.
- **Lane C**: Round-robin RM assignment, CRM upsert, delivery status tracking, and 1-minute recovery dispatcher.

parameters.query:
WITH ins_c AS (
  INSERT INTO leadqual_sw.contacts (phone_e164, name)
  VALUES ($1, $2)
  ON CONFLICT (phone_e164) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name
  RETURNING id
),
ins_conv AS (
  INSERT INTO leadqual_sw.conversations (contact_id, project_name, state, qualification_step)
  SELECT id, $3, 'in_progress', 'AWAITING_PURPOSE' FROM ins_c
  ON CONFLICT (contact_id) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING id, contact_id
)
INSERT INTO leadqual_sw.pending_actions (conversation_id, contact_id, action_type, payload)
SELECT c.id, c.contact_id, 'whatsapp_send', jsonb_build_object('kind', 'initial_outreach', 'name', $2)
FROM ins_conv c
RETURNING id, conversation_id;

UPDATE leadqual_sw.conversations SET automation_paused = true, state = 'OPTED_OUT', updated_at = NOW() WHERE contact_id = (SELECT id FROM leadqual_sw.contacts WHERE phone_e164 = $1);
UPDATE leadqual_sw.pending_actions SET status = 'cancelled' WHERE contact_id = (SELECT id FROM leadqual_sw.contacts WHERE phone_e164 = $1) AND status = 'pending';

SELECT c.id AS conversation_id, c.contact_id, c.qualification_step, c.automation_paused, con.phone_e164, con.name
FROM leadqual_sw.conversations c
JOIN leadqual_sw.contacts con ON con.id = c.contact_id
WHERE con.phone_e164 = $1 AND c.automation_paused = false
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO leadqual_sw.pending_actions (conversation_id, contact_id, action_type, payload)
VALUES ($1, $2, 'whatsapp_send', jsonb_build_object('kind', 'clarification', 'step', $3));

WITH lock_c AS (
  SELECT id, version FROM leadqual_sw.conversations WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE
),
up_ans AS (
  INSERT INTO leadqual_sw.qualification_answers (conversation_id, field, value)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
  ON CONFLICT (conversation_id, field) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value
  RETURNING conversation_id
)
UPDATE leadqual_sw.conversations c
SET version = l.version + 1, qualification_step = $4, updated_at = NOW()
FROM lock_c l
WHERE c.id = $1
RETURNING c.id, c.qualification_step;
SELECT field, value FROM leadqual_sw.qualification_answers WHERE conversation_id = $1;

UPDATE leadqual_sw.pending_actions
SET status = 'claimed', claimed_at = NOW()
WHERE id IN (
  SELECT id FROM leadqual_sw.pending_actions
  WHERE status = 'pending' AND scheduled_at <= NOW()
  ORDER BY scheduled_at ASC
  LIMIT 25
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
RETURNING *;

SELECT 
  c.phone_e164 AS contact_phone,
  c.name AS contact_name,
  co.project_name,
  co.qualification_step,
  co.automation_paused
FROM leadqual_sw.contacts c
JOIN leadqual_sw.conversations co ON co.id = $2
WHERE c.id = $1
LIMIT 1;
UPDATE leadqual_sw.pending_actions SET status = 'sent', completed_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1;
